title: AN EMPTY MAGAZINE IS HALF GREY
why: His order of 2026-10-12: guns on the belt should grey out only half way when the magazine is empty but you carry ammo to reload, and grey out fully only when you are completely out of ammo. A gun key with an empty magazine looked exactly like a gun with nothing left. Now a loaded gun is full colour, a gun with an empty magazine and ammo to load is half grey with its 0 in the amber of the RELOAD prompt, and a gun with no ammo anywhere is fully grey as before. It covers the gun in your hands, the stowed one and a backpack gun on a gun key, and changes the moment you pick up, load or spend ammo. Bare hands never grey.
now: A gun with an empty magazine and ammo to reload is now half grey on the belt; fully grey only when all ammo is gone.
